# Caterpillar ScreenSaver
Caterpillar ScreenSaver: a caterpillar eating out your desktop

![VB.NET](https://img.shields.io/badge/VB.NET-512BD4?style=for-the-badge&logo=.net&logoColor=white)

## Authors

* [@remusrigo](https://github.com/RemusRigo)
* [@remusrigo](https://sourceforge.net/u/remusrigo/profile)



## Features

* Background image of the screensaver will be (in this order):
  * %LocalAppData%\Remus RIGO\SnapDesktop\Desktop.png (generated by [SnapDesktop](https://github.com/RemusRigo/SnapDesktop-VB.NET))
  * default Wallpaper file
  * draw on the background the solid color of the current Windows theme
* Multi-Monitor support (including monitors with different scaling)



## User's Guide

See the [User's Guide](UsersGuide.md) for downloads, runtimes, installation and settings.

## Roadmap

* 2026-10-12: Fix: Settings: "About..." system-menu ID (must be a multiple of 16)

* 2026-10-12: Fix: Desktop.png is ignored if its size doesn't match the current monitor layout (falls back to the wallpaper)
* 2026-10-12: Fix: Settings defaults: missing registry values fall back to the app defaults (Speed, Size, Color)
* 2026-10-12: Upd: Faster drawing: brushes and pen created once, not every frame

* 2026-10-12: Fix: Crash on startup with an empty or one-character command-line argument
